capabilities: embed files located outside the vault
link files with absolute or relative paths
define device groups with per-device base paths
link to any file type Obsidian can handle
extras: Supports Windows, Linux, MacOS, Android, and iOS; can be installed manually via BRAT (Kay607/obsidian-pathlinker). Group names are not updated in existing links if renamed.
problem: Obsidian embeds only resolve inside the vault, so files kept in external folders or synced folders on different devices cannot be embedded directly.

relations.evidence: having a Dropbox folder in multiple locations on different devices

summary: Plugin that embeds files stored outside the vault into notes using ![[external:]] links, with device-specific base paths for groups.
